beliefs.instruction: Do not nest Manim animation objects (e.g., Circumscribe, Flash, Indicate) inside introducer animations like FadeIn. Pass the animation object directly to self.play() to avoid a TypeError, as introducers require Mobject arguments, not other Animation instances.

scope.problem_description: TypeError during render when an animation object is incorrectly passed as an argument to another animation constructor.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to the mechanism of passing an Animation instance into another Animation's constructor.

beliefs.instruction: For large or complex mobject groups (such as Axes with plots or VGroups), use place_in_area with a multi-cell span (e.g., 'B2' to 'E5') rather than place_at_grid to ensure centering and panel separation. For coordinate systems, group Axes and their curves/points into a single VGroup before applying the layout method to keep them spatially synchronized.

scope.problem_description: Visual elements overlapping the lecture text panel or coordinate systems becoming desynchronized during layout transformations.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates area-based placement strategy with the requirement to group dependent coordinate elements before transformation.

beliefs.instruction: When creating MathTex mobjects, isolate variables intended for targeted animation (e.g., set_color, Indicate) into independent string arguments. Indexing in Manim MathTex is determined by the input strings; grouping symbols in one string prevents the selection of individual components for precise visual effects.

scope.problem_description: Incorrect sub-mobject selection when attempting to animate specific parts of a LaTeX formula.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Single mechanism of sub-mobject indexing in MathTex based on string isolation.

beliefs.instruction: Adjust self.wait() durations to be proportional to the word count of the lecture lines (approx. 0.4 seconds per word) with a minimum of 2 seconds. In complex scenes with dense formulas, ensure the terminal wait is at least 7-10 seconds to avoid rapid pacing that hinders learner absorption.

scope.problem_description: Learners are unable to absorb information because scene transitions occur too quickly or simple scenes have excessive dead time.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Combines terminal wait and intermediate pacing into a single proportional-timing principle supported by conflicting evidence on fixed thresholds.

beliefs.instruction: Avoid using semantically ambiguous or metaphorical icons (e.g., an airplane for a geometric plane) to represent abstract entities. Use standard Manim geometric primitives (Rectangle, Square) or literal SVGs to ensure conceptual clarity and reduce cognitive dissonance.

scope.problem_description: Learner confusion caused by metaphorical rather than literal asset representation of mathematical objects.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific pedagogical mechanism regarding metaphorical vs literal representation.

beliefs.instruction: Maintain consistent visual style, fidelity, and dimensionality across all sections. Do not mix disparate design languages (e.g., rudimentary line art, flat-design icons, and photorealistic raster images) or change animation density abruptly in the summary unless required for comparative demonstration.

scope.problem_description: Inconsistent visual identity and style shifts reducing video professionalism and creating a disjointed learner experience.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Unifies dimensionality, fidelity, and density into a broad visual consistency principle.

beliefs.instruction: Ensure logical closure in concluding synthesis sections by defining all terms and displaying intermediate formulas (e.g., integral steps for coefficients) that link prerequisites to the final result. No new terminology (e.g., 'directrix') should appear for the first time in the summary.

scope.problem_description: Breakdown in logical scaffolding when new concepts or missing derivation links appear in the summary.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates address the same mechanism of logical gaps in the final synthesis/summary.

beliefs.instruction: Animate the mechanical relationships (the 'how' and 'why') described by active process verbs (e.g., 'slides', 'flips', 'updating') using dynamic transformations like morphing, continuous motion paths, or area expansion. Avoid using static reveals or simplistic highlights to represent mechanical operations.

scope.problem_description: Educational content lacks explanatory depth or has a disconnect between script verbs and static visual representations.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates the need for dynamic motion and verb-alignment to explain mechanical causes.

beliefs.instruction: When applying animations to collections (lists like self.mobjects or Graph dictionaries), do not pass the collection directly to the animation constructor. Use the unpacking operator (*) for lists (e.g., FadeOut(*self.mobjects)) or wrap dictionary values in a VGroup (e.g., VGroup(*graph.vertices.values())) to avoid TypeErrors.

scope.problem_description: TypeError or AttributeError when attempting to animate internal data structures or lists of mobjects.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both address TypeErrors resulting from passing data structures instead of Mobjects to animation classes.

beliefs.instruction: In Manim, use the 'Annulus' class for circular shapes with holes; do not use 'Ring', as it is not a standard primitive and will trigger a NameError.

scope.problem_description: NameError when attempting to instantiate a non-existent 'Ring' mobject.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to a single non-existent class in the Manim API.

beliefs.instruction: In dual-panel layouts, confine mobjects to columns 3-6 and maintain a clear 1-unit horizontal gutter (typically Column 2 or 'B') between the left lecture text and right-side visuals. Only utilize all columns if the coordinate system is explicitly centered (x >= 0.5) to avoid 'poor grid utilization'.

scope.problem_description: Animation mobjects overlapping or sitting too close to the persistent lecture text panel.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates the column-restriction rule with the conditional adjustment for center-offset grids.

beliefs.instruction: Synchronize the dimensionality of mathematical formulas with their visual representations (e.g., 1D sequence formulas must use 1D sequence visuals) to avoid conceptual dissonance.

scope.problem_description: Learner confusion caused by mismatch between formula dimensionality and visual demonstration.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Distinct mechanism regarding dimensional mapping.

beliefs.instruction: Replace abstract placeholders with concrete numerical examples and step-by-step calculations (e.g., using integer values like 3^x=81) for iterative or operational concepts. Numerical walkthroughs are essential for técnico mastery and bridging theory to practice.

scope.problem_description: Educational content lacks depth required for teaching specific calculation procedures.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Focuses on numerical grounding as a pedagogical depth mechanism.

beliefs.instruction: Prefer dedicated grid-cell placement for general label alignment (e.g., Row B for a target in Row C). However, for objects requiring precise anchors (such as vector tips), group the mobject and label in a VGroup using .next_to() before applying layout transformations.

scope.problem_description: Labels appearing detached or poorly aligned with targets when using grid coordinates or groups.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates the grid labeling rule with the necessary exception for anchored vector labels.

beliefs.instruction: Do not use a non-existent 'HGroup' class in Manim. Use 'VGroup' and apply the '.arrange(RIGHT)' method to achieve horizontal alignment.

scope.problem_description: NameError during render when attempting to use hallucinated 'HGroup' for horizontal layout.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to a common agent-hallucinated class name.

beliefs.instruction: Reserve Row A and the top-most cells of Row B as empty visual buffers for the section title. Only utilize Row A if the primary title is anchored to the screen edge (UP) and mobjects are scaled (<= 0.7) to ensure proper vertical breathing room.

scope.problem_description: Visual elements in the animation panel crowding or overlapping the section title.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates Row A/B buffer rule with the conditional exception for title-edge anchoring.

beliefs.instruction: When using Python raw strings (r'...') for MathTex, use single backslashes for LaTeX commands (e.g., r'\frac'). Avoid double-escaping (r'\\frac'), as it can pass literal double backslashes to the compiler, potentially causing compilation failure.

scope.problem_description: LaTeX compilation error in Manim due to double-escaped backslashes in raw strings.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to Python/LaTeX escaping interaction.

beliefs.instruction: Do not pass advanced styling arguments (e.g., 'dash_array', 'dash_length', 'opacity') directly into VMobject or plot_surface constructors. Instead, apply these properties using specialized methods (.set_color_by_gradient, .set_opacity) or wrap the mobject in a specific class (DashedVMobject) to avoid TypeErrors.

scope.problem_description: TypeError or NameError when attempting to use unsupported keyword arguments or classes for visual effects.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates instances where advanced styles must be applied via methods/wrappers rather than constructor keywords.

beliefs.instruction: Use simple Manim primitives (Dot, Square) as fallbacks when asset references are named 'none' or 'placeholder' in the storyboard. Avoid introducing irrelevant default icons (e.g., a microphone) that break semantic context.

scope.problem_description: Irrelevant placeholder icons appearing when specific assets are unavailable.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific mechanism of asset fallback management.

beliefs.instruction: For statistical concepts involving aggregation (e.g., CLT), explicitly animate the literal movement of elements from source population to sample, then to their transformation into a statistic, before plotting them.

scope.problem_description: Learners find statistical distributions abstract if the sampling process is not visually linked to data points.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Distinct pedagogical intervention for statistical modeling.

beliefs.instruction: Strictly adhere to the provided signatures of custom base class methods (e.g., place_at_grid). Do not pass standard Manim kwargs (e.g., 'shift') or hallucinated convenience methods (e.g., 'add_label') suggested by review agents unless they are explicitly defined in the local implementation.

scope.problem_description: TypeError or AttributeError caused by assuming custom layout methods support standard Manim parameters or non-existent helper methods.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates failures where Agents assume non-existent API features or incorrect method signatures in custom scenes.

beliefs.instruction: Do not use .get_midpoint() on VGroups or DashedLines; use .get_center() instead. These collections lack continuous paths and will trigger a point_from_proportion exception.

scope.problem_description: Render failure (Exception) when attempting to find midpoints of mobject collections.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to technical path-interpolation limitations in Manim.

beliefs.instruction: Instantiate 3D surfaces first, then apply color and opacity via .set_color() and .set_opacity(). Passing these as keyword arguments directly to axes.plot_surface() triggers a TypeError.

scope.problem_description: TypeError when attempting to set visual properties inside plot_surface.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Isolated mechanism regarding plot_surface kwarg restrictions.

beliefs.instruction: Employ established pedagogical analogies (e.g., 'hilly landscape' for loss functions, 'sniffer dog' for Bayes) in the lecture script to provide an intuitive conceptual anchor for abstract algorithms.

scope.problem_description: Learners struggle to grasp abstract technical concepts without an intuitive conceptual anchor.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates specific evidence on the utility of analogies for abstract topics.

beliefs.instruction: Avoid rapid, non-semantic color cycling or complex motion that does not map to a technical state change described in the script, as it creates visual noise.

scope.problem_description: Non-semantic animations distract learners from core concepts.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to non-functional visual noise.

beliefs.instruction: Structure introductory conceptual lessons into five distinct phases: (1) an intuitive hook, (2) essential prerequisites, (3) formal definition, (4) visual synthesis/demonstration, and (5) real-world application. For theorems, ensure prerequisites (e.g., independence) are reviewed immediately before the core definition.

scope.problem_description: Abstract definitions feel unmotivated or difficult to grasp without logical scaffolding.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Unifies the 5-phase structure with specific scaffolding requirements for theorem introduction.

beliefs.instruction: Coordinate the color highlighting of technical keywords in the lecture text with the stroke/fill colors of corresponding mobjects to reduce cognitive mapping load for the learner.

scope.problem_description: Cognitive load increases when mapping text to disparate visual elements without color cues.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Isolated mechanism regarding color-based semantic mapping.

beliefs.instruction: Prefer .animate syntax over legacy ApplyMethod to align with modern Manim standards and reduce code complexity.

scope.problem_description: Redundant code complexity and potential legacy compatibility issues.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to syntax preference/maintainability.

beliefs.instruction: Do not use a non-existent 'Curve' class. Use 'ArcBetweenPoints' or 'CubicBezier' for trajectories.

scope.problem_description: NameError when attempting to use a generic 'Curve' class.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to a common hallucinated class name.

beliefs.instruction: Explicitly visualize or describe the shear-invariance property in geometric proofs (e.g., Cramer's Rule) to explain why area is preserved during vector additions, closing logical gaps for the learner.

scope.problem_description: Logical gaps in proofs where area equality is assumed without explanation.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Distinct pedagogical requirement for geometric proof completeness.

beliefs.instruction: Visualize non-Archimedean metrics (e.g., p-adic) using hierarchical models like nested disks or tree diagrams rather than linear number lines to accurately represent divisibility-based distance.

scope.problem_description: Learner confusion when non-Archimedean distances are represented using Euclidean geometry.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to non-Euclidean metric space visualization.

beliefs.instruction: Consolidate triadic operations (e.g., powers, roots, logs) in a final synthesis using a single geometric frame (like a triangle) to emphasize their unified relationship.

scope.problem_description: Learners perceive related inverse operations as isolated procedures.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific visual synthesis strategy for inverse operations.

beliefs.instruction: Use hexadecimal strings (e.g., '#00FFFF') for all color specifications to prevent NameErrors, as named constants like 'CYAN' are not globally available in all environments.

scope.problem_description: NameError during render when using standard color name constants.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Isolated mechanism regarding environment-specific color constant failures.

beliefs.instruction: When visualizing physical interactions (splitting, reflection), represent all causal elements (source, object, recording medium) rather than only the resulting rays/waves to maintain script-to-visual grounding.

scope.problem_description: Visual representation omits physical objects described in the text, hindering comprehension.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Distinct requirement for physical demonstration depth.

beliefs.instruction: Distribute multiple distinct mobjects (e.g., vectors, lines) across unique grid cells rather than stacking them at the same coordinate to prevent occlusion and conceptual confusion.

scope.problem_description: Visual stacking of multiple mobjects in the same grid cell leads to occlusion.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Isolated layout mechanism regarding mobject stacking.

beliefs.instruction: Group the text-highlighting animation and the corresponding mobject animation within the same self.play() call. Sequential calls create a perceptual lag that disrupts the link between verbal and visual information.

scope.problem_description: Desynchronization between highlighted lecture text and visual explanation.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Focuses on temporal synchronization in self.play() calls.

beliefs.instruction: Explicitly define technical jargon (e.g., 'wavenumber', 'isotropy') and label all plot components (axes, regimes like 'dissipation range') using Text or MathTex mobjects. Do not rely on viewer inference for mapping terms to visual structures.

scope.problem_description: Undefined technical jargon and unlabeled diagrams preventing learner grounding.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates requirements for explicit labeling of technical terminology and diagram regimes.

beliefs.instruction: When the storyboard describes a specific mathematical refinement (e.g., sqrt(d_k) scaling), the on-screen MathTex must explicitly display that term to ground the visual action.

scope.problem_description: Disconnect between visual transformations and the symbolic formulas shown on screen.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to symbolic-visual alignment for scaling factors.

beliefs.instruction: Visualize parallel attention heads using distinct colors or spatial offsets before convergence to communicate the parallel architecture intuitively.

scope.problem_description: Abstract single-color representations of parallel processes are difficult to interpret.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to multi-head attention visualization.

beliefs.instruction: Synchronize numerical values in MathTex (e.g., matrix entries) with the geometric properties (e.g., vector direction) of corresponding mobjects to avoid severe cognitive dissonance.

scope.problem_description: Inconsistency between symbolic and visual representation of the same mathematical object.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Distinct mechanism regarding value-level consistency between symbols and geometry.

beliefs.instruction: Apply multiple inheritance (e.g., class SectionScene(TeachingScene, MovingCameraScene)) when combining custom layout helpers and camera frame manipulation to prevent AttributeErrors for camera.frame.

scope.problem_description: AttributeError when attempting to use camera.frame in a Scene inheriting only from a custom base class.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to scene inheritance and camera attribute failures.

beliefs.instruction: Explicitly FadeOut text mobjects before or during a camera zoom that moves the frame away from the text area to avoid abrupt visual cuts.

scope.problem_description: Abrupt visual disappearance of text during camera zooms or pans.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Focuses on smooth layout exits during camera motion.

beliefs.instruction: Do not use non-existent 'Checkmark' class; use Tex(r'$\checkmark$') or SVGMobject to render checkmark symbols and avoid NameErrors.

scope.problem_description: NameError during render caused by non-existent Manim classes for symbols.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to the checkmark symbol class hallucination.

beliefs.instruction: Place mobjects intended for direct comparison in adjacent grid cells (e.g., D3, D4) to minimize eye travel and facilitate identification of differences.

scope.problem_description: Learner difficulty in parsing comparisons due to excessive spatial distance between targets.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Isolated layout principle regarding comparison proximity.

beliefs.instruction: Restrict scale factor of secondary emphasis mobjects (checkmarks, arrows) to 0.8-1.2. Excessive scaling disruptions visual hierarchy.

scope.problem_description: Emphasis icons dominating visual hierarchy due to excessive scaling.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific scale-factor bounds for secondary objects.

beliefs.instruction: Anchor announcement text (e.g., 'Pattern Broken!') within the same visual rows or columns as the primary data it describes to maintain layout cohesion.

scope.problem_description: Summary text feels detached from supporting visual evidence.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Focuses on spatial association between announcements and data.

beliefs.instruction: Store target values for updaters or always_redraw in a ValueTracker. Passing primitive numeric types (float, int) inside lambdas causes an AttributeError during render.

scope.problem_description: Render crash (AttributeError) when retrieving values from primitive numbers in updaters.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific to updater interface requirements in Manim.

beliefs.instruction: Proactively apply a scale factor (0.4-0.7) to large containers (Axes, NumberPlane) in dual-panel layouts to avoid overlap with text panels and titles.

scope.problem_description: Default mobject sizes causing crowding or overlap with text panels.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific proactive scaling bounds for large containers.

beliefs.instruction: Do not assign values to self.time; it is a reserved read-only property for the internal clock. Use alternative names (e.g., self.current_time) for custom state variables.

scope.problem_description: AttributeError during render when assigning to the reserved self.time property.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Isolated mechanism regarding reserved Manim Scene attributes.

beliefs.instruction: Replace continuous per-frame updaters and complex path tracking (TracedPath) with discrete .animate transformations for simple movements to prevent render timeouts in complex scenes.

scope.problem_description: Render timeouts caused by excessive per-frame redraw operations.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific performance optimization for render time reduction.

beliefs.instruction: Use MoveAlongPath with the relevant curve object rather than .animate.move_to for constrained physics demonstrations (e.g., bead on a wire) to ensure visual accuracy.

scope.problem_description: Physical demonstrations appearing inaccurate because motion does not follow intended geometric paths.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Isolated mechanism regarding path-based motion vs linear interpolation.
